items.exampleEn: In our small team, nobody is dispensable.
items.exampleZh: 在我們的小團隊裡，沒有人是可有可無的。

items.exampleEn: Glass is breakable, so we use plastic cups at the pool.
items.exampleZh: 玻璃容易破，所以我們在泳池邊用塑膠杯。

items.exampleEn: Baking requires exactness; a little too much sugar can change the cake.
items.exampleZh: 烘焙講求精確，糖多放一點點就會改變蛋糕。

items.exampleEn: The mutability of language means that new words appear every year.
items.exampleZh: 語言的多變，代表每年都有新字出現。

items.exampleEn: The old man's untrimmed beard reached his chest.
items.exampleZh: 那位老人沒修剪的鬍子長到胸口。

items.exampleEn: The clearness of her explanation helped everyone understand.
items.exampleZh: 她解釋得很清楚，大家都聽懂了。

items.exampleEn: House prices here were unthinkably low fifty years ago.
items.exampleZh: 五十年前，這裡的房價低得難以想像。
items.glossZh: 難以想像地；不可思議地

items.exampleEn: Everyone noticed the unusualness of his accent.
items.exampleZh: 大家都注意到他的口音很不尋常。

items.sentenceEn: The story is about the mutability of human memory.
items.sentenceZh: 這個故事講的是人類記憶的善變。

items.audioEn: The unusualness of the cafe's furniture attracts many visitors, but the food is quite ordinary.
items.audioZh: 那家咖啡館家具的與眾不同吸引了許多客人，不過餐點很普通。

items.sentenceEn: The architect checked every line of the drawing with great exactness.
items.sentenceZh: 建築師非常精確地檢查圖上的每一條線。

items.sentenceEn: The concert tickets sold out unthinkably quickly.
items.sentenceZh: 演唱會門票賣完的速度快得不可思議。

items.stemEn: Don't play ball in the living room; the vase on the table is ____.
items.stemZh: 別在客廳玩球，桌上的花瓶很容易碎。

items.stemEn: On a day like this, the ____ of the sky lets you see the mountains far away.
items.stemZh: 在這樣的日子裡，天空很清澈，可以看見遠方的山。

items.passageEn: Last spring, my family moved to an old house in the countryside. Before the move, we wrapped every breakable cup in newspaper and decided that many of our things were dispensable, so we gave them away. The new house had an untrimmed lawn full of tall grass, and it took my father a whole weekend to cut it. At first, the unusualness of country life made us a little nervous, because there were no shops nearby. Behind the house there is a small stream, and the clearness of its water surprised us all.
items.passageZh: 去年春天，我們家搬到鄉下一棟老房子。搬家前，我們用報紙把每個易碎的杯子包好，也覺得很多東西其實可有可無，就送給別人了。新家有一片沒修剪、長滿高草的草坪，我爸爸花了整個週末才割完。一開始，鄉下生活的與眾不同讓我們有點不安，因為附近沒有商店。房子後面有一條小溪，溪水的清澈讓我們都很驚訝。

questions.questionZh: 搬家前他們怎麼處理很多東西？
爸爸花了整個週末做什麼？

items.promptZh: 這支手機的一些額外功能其實可有可無。
referenceEn: Some of the extra features of this phone are actually dispensable.
Some extra features on this phone are not really necessary; they are dispensable.
rubricZh: 要用 dispensable（例如 are dispensable）
「額外功能」可寫，例如 extra features、additional features 等

items.promptZh: 公園裡沒修剪的樹枝擋住了路燈。
referenceEn: The untrimmed branches in the park are blocking the street lights.
Untrimmed branches in the park have blocked the street lights.
rubricZh: untrimmed 當形容詞放名詞前（例如 untrimmed branches 等）
「擋住」可寫，例如 block、cover 等；時態可用現在式、進行式或完成式（例如 block、are blocking 等）
